nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the contract owner in contract owned.
Constructor of contract owned that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that reassigns the owner state variable to newOwner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances, allowances and modifiers.
Public token name string set in the TokenERC20 constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the TokenERC20 constructor.
Public uint8 decimals used as exponent when minting the initial supply.
Public uint256 total token supply, mutated by constructor, burn and burnFrom.
Public mapping of address balances, read and written by every transfer path.
Public nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount, mutated by approve/transferFrom/burnFrom.
TokenERC20 constructor: sets totalSupply from initialSupply * 10**decimals and credits msg.sender.
Internal transfer primitive that mutates balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic and asserts invariants.
Public TokenERC20 transfer that delegates to _transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public allowance-based transfer that decrements allowance then calls _transfer.
Public function writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Public function that approves a spender and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Public function destroying the caller's tokens and decrementing totalSupply.
Public function burning tokens of _from using the caller's allowance.
Untrusted external call to tokenRecipient(_spender).receiveApproval executed before state finalisation.
Unchecked multiplication when minting the initial supply in the TokenERC20 constructor.
Unchecked addition crediting the recipient inside _transfer.
Unchecked subtraction of totalSupply in burn.
Unchecked subtraction of totalSupply in burnFrom.
SafeMath multiplication guarded by an assert on the reverse division.
SafeMath division guarded by asserts on divisor and remainder.
SafeMath subtraction guarded by assert(b <= a).
SafeMath addition guarded by an overflow assert.
Internal mapping address=>TokenLocked storing the lock schedule of each holder.
Internal mapping address=>bool flagging whether a holder is subject to a lock.
LockedToken constructor forwarding initialSupply, tokenName and tokenSymbol to TokenERC20.
LockedToken.transfer guarded by the canTransfer modifier, delegating to super.transfer.
LockedToken.transferFrom guarded by canTransfer(_from,_value), delegating to super.transferFrom.
onlyOwner function that stores a TokenLocked schedule, flags isLocked and transfers tokens.
Public view returning transferableTokens(_holder, uint64(now)).
Public view computing the unlocked portion of a balance using time-based vesting math with SafeMath.
Public view returning now or the stored lastDate of a locked holder.
Payable fallback function of LockedToken that always reverts.
Block timestamp (now) driving the lock/vesting calculations.

edges.reason: owned() constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender as owner, establishing the privileged account.
owner state variable is compared with msg.sender inside the onlyOwner modifier of transferOwnership.
msg.sender must equal owner for transferOwnership to execute, gating the ownership transfer.
newOwner parameter is written into the owner state variable.
initialSupply feeds the unchecked exponentiation/multiplication that mints the supply.
decimals is used as the exponent in 10**uint256(decimals) during minting.
Result of the unchecked multiplication is stored into totalSupply.
msg.sender balance is initialised with the whole totalSupply in the constructor.
_transfer reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for both _from and _to.
_to is used as the key of the unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value addition.
_value is added to the recipient balance without SafeMath protection.
_transfer executes the unchecked credit of the recipient balance.
The unchecked addition mutates the balanceOf mapping.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath inside _transfer.
TokenERC20.transfer delegates the whole transfer logic to internal _transfer.
msg.sender is passed as _from into _transfer by transfer.
transfer _value is forwarded to the internal _transfer call.
transfer _to is forwarded to the internal _transfer call.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer after reducing the allowance.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is checked and decremented inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is the spender index of allowance[_from][msg.sender] authorising the transfer.
_from indexes the outer key of the allowance mapping in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from the allowance entry with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom _value is forwarded to _transfer.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance entry written by approve.
_spender is the inner key of the allowance entry written by approve.
approveAndCall first invokes the internal approve function.
approveAndCall invokes an attacker-controlled external receiveApproval on the spender contract.
The external spender contract can re-enter the token contract through the receiveApproval callback.
_spender is cast to tokenRecipient, so the user controls the address of the external call.
msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument of receiveApproval.
burn executes the unchecked totalSupply -= _value subtraction.
totalSupply is read and decremented without SafeMath in burn.
The unchecked subtraction writes the new totalSupply value.
burnFrom executes the unchecked totalSupply -= _value subtraction.
burnFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
msg.sender must hold an allowance from _from for burnFrom to succeed.
_from balance is decremented without SafeMath in burnFrom.
block.timestamp (now) determines the result of spendableBalanceOf.
spendableBalanceOf delegates to transferableTokens passing uint64(now) as the time argument.
The miner-influenced timestamp drives the vesting comparisons against startDate and lastDate.
now is returned as the default value of lastTokenIsTransferableDate for unlocked holders.
transferableTokens reads the holder lock schedule from lockedTokenOf.
isLocked[holder] gates whether the vesting calculation is applied at all.
balanceOf[holder] is compared with lockedAmount and used to derive the transferable amount.
transferableTokens calls safeMul when computing the vested portion.
transferableTokens calls safeDiv when computing the vested portion.
transferableTokens calls safeSub for the time and amount deltas.
LockedToken constructor invokes the TokenERC20 constructor with the same arguments.
The canTransfer modifier of LockedToken.transfer calls spendableBalanceOf.
msg.sender is passed to canTransfer together with _value before the transfer executes.
LockedToken.transfer forwards to super.transfer (TokenERC20.transfer).
The canTransfer modifier of LockedToken.transferFrom calls spendableBalanceOf with _from.
LockedToken.transferFrom forwards to super.transferFrom (TokenERC20.transferFrom).
_from is used as the holder whose spendable balance is checked by canTransfer.
transferAndLock writes the new TokenLocked struct into lockedTokenOf[_to].
transferAndLock sets isLocked[_to] = true, activating the vesting restriction.
transferAndLock calls super.transfer after persisting the lock schedule.
owner is compared with msg.sender by the onlyOwner modifier protecting transferAndLock.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner for the privileged transferAndLock entry point.
_startDate is stored in the TokenLocked struct used by later vesting calculations.
_lastDate is stored in the TokenLocked struct and later compared with the block timestamp.
_batches is stored in the TokenLocked struct and used in the vesting division.

normalization_plan.reason: initialSupply is only a constructor argument for the unchecked minting multiplication; it is not tracked as an independent value.
tokenName is written directly into the name state variable by the TokenERC20 constructor.
tokenSymbol is written directly into the symbol state variable by the TokenERC20 constructor.
newOwner is only an input to transferOwnership and is immediately stored into owner.
_from is a positional argument of _transfer and does not need its own symbolic value.
_to is a positional argument of _transfer used only as a mapping key.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value operation in _transfer.
_to is a positional argument of TokenERC20.transfer forwarded to _transfer.
_value is a positional argument of TokenERC20.transfer forwarded to _transfer.
_from is a positional argument of transferFrom used as an allowance mapping key.
_to is a positional argument of transferFrom forwarded to _transfer.
_value is the operand of the unchecked allowance decrement in transferFrom.
_spender is a positional argument of approve used as an allowance mapping key.
_value is the assignment operand of allowance in approve.
_spender is cast to tokenRecipient and therefore determines the external call target.
_value is a positional argument of approveAndCall forwarded to approve and receiveApproval.
_extraData is opaque bytes forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
_value is the operand of the unchecked totalSupply subtraction in burn.
_from is a positional argument of burnFrom used as a balance and allowance key.
_value is the operand of the unchecked totalSupply subtraction in burnFrom.
a is a positional arithmetic argument of safeMul and carries no separate security meaning.
b is a positional arithmetic argument of safeMul and carries no separate security meaning.
a is a positional arithmetic argument of safeDiv.
b is the divisor argument of safeDiv asserted to be non-zero.
a is a positional arithmetic argument of safeSub.
b is the subtrahend argument of safeSub asserted to be <= a.
a is a positional arithmetic argument of safeAdd.
b is a positional arithmetic argument of safeAdd.
_to is a positional argument of LockedToken.transfer forwarded to super.transfer.
_value is the amount checked by canTransfer in LockedToken.transfer.
_from is the holder checked by canTransfer in LockedToken.transferFrom.
_to is a positional argument of LockedToken.transferFrom forwarded to super.transferFrom.
_value is the amount checked by canTransfer in LockedToken.transferFrom.
_to is the key used for lockedTokenOf, isLocked and the super.transfer call in transferAndLock.
_value is stored as the locked amount and then transferred in transferAndLock.
_startDate is only stored into the TokenLocked struct by transferAndLock.
_lastDate is only stored into the TokenLocked struct by transferAndLock.
_batches is only stored into the TokenLocked struct by transferAndLock.
_holder is a positional argument of spendableBalanceOf forwarded to transferableTokens.
holder is a positional argument used as a mapping key in transferableTokens.
time is the comparison operand for the vesting math in transferableTokens.
holder is a positional argument used as a mapping key in lastTokenIsTransferableDate.
previousBalances is an internal bookkeeping local used only by the final assert of _transfer.
spender is the local handle whose receiveApproval invocation is the external call of interest.
tokenLocked is the temporary struct persisted into lockedTokenOf by transferAndLock.
tokenLocked is the storage pointer to the current holder lock entry in transferableTokens.
amount is a local copy of tokenLocked.amount used only inside transferableTokens.
startDate is a local copy of tokenLocked.startDate used only inside transferableTokens.
lastDate is a local copy of tokenLocked.lastDate used only inside transferableTokens.
batches is a local copy of tokenLocked.batches used only inside transferableTokens.
originalTransferableTokens is an intermediate SafeMath result inside transferableTokens.
lockedAmount is an intermediate SafeMath result inside transferableTokens.
actualTransferableTokens is the return value derived inside transferableTokens.
date is the returned local of lastTokenIsTransferableDate initialised to now.
